A /16 prefix covers a range of 65,536 addresses. 

If the network address is **X.Y.0.0**, the range covers all addresses from **X.Y.0.0** to **X.Y.255.255**.

To get the specific range for your address, replace X and Y with the first two octets of your provided address.
